description: This file defines a record class 'SiloMetadata' used for storing metadata information related to silos in Orleans cluster management. It includes a static empty instance, a property for storing key-value metadata pairs, and internal methods for adding metadata entries.

classes.name: SiloMetadata
classes.description: A record representing metadata associated with a silo in Orleans, with an immutable dictionary of key-value pairs and methods for updating metadata.

methods.name: AddMetadata(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string>> metadata)
methods.description: Internal method to add multiple metadata entries to the existing Metadata dictionary.

methods.name: AddMetadata(string key, string value)
methods.description: Internal method to add a single metadata entry to the Metadata dictionary.
